module: Unit tests of the ui_arrowGPS extension (floating on-screen GPS arrow). The file loads arrowGPS.lua in a simulated environment (fake TSStatic createObject, fake core_camera, GFXDevice, scenetree) via loadfile + setfenv, then checks the lazy creation of the arrow, its reuse, its color, its rotation toward the highest-priority target and its recreation after the object is deleted. Useful to a modder to understand the ui_arrowGPS contract (setTarget, removeTarget, setScale, setDepth, setAppScreenPos, onPreRender).
notes: This is not a game extension: the module is run by testFramework/TestManager, not by extensions.load.
Each test receives a ctx context (assert, assertEqual, assertNear) provided by the TestManager.

Contract inferred from the tests: the arrow is only created on the first onPreRender with a target AND a player vehicle; the smallest priority value wins (priority 1 before 10); the shape used is art/shapes/interface/s_mm_arrow_floating.dae and the default color is '1 0.4 0.2 1'.

testIdleExtensionDoesNotCreateArrow.desc: Checks that no object is created as long as no valid target (with pos) is set: onPreRender, setTarget without pos, removeTarget and onExtensionUnloaded create nothing.

testTargetWaitsForPlayerAndRender.desc: Checks that the arrow waits for a player vehicle and an onPreRender: without a player nothing is created, as soon as the player exists the arrow is created and visible.

testRenderedArrowIsReusedAndHidesWithout.desc: Checks the default color and shape, that the arrow is hidden when the player disappears then shown again, without recreation (a single object created).

testPriorityColorAndTargetRemoval.desc: Checks that the lowest-priority target (1) dictates the arrow's color and direction, that removeTarget switches to the next target, and that the arrow is hidden when there is no target left.

testSceneDeletionRecreatesArrowWithoutTa.desc: Checks that if the scene object is deleted, onPreRender recreates the arrow keeping color and scale (setScale), without a new call to setTarget.

testTargetUpdateAfterSceneDeletionDoesNo.desc: Checks that a setTarget/setScale after the object's deletion does not access the old object (the fake object raises an error otherwise) and that the recreation happens at the next onPreRender.

testSettingsBeforeCreationAffectFirstRen.desc: Checks that setScale, setDepth and setAppScreenPos called before the arrow is created are taken into account from the first render (scale 0.08, depth 0.3, screen position 0.75/0.25).

testUnloadClearsObjectAndTargetState.desc: Checks that onExtensionUnloaded deletes the object and empties the targets state, and that the extension remains usable afterwards with new targets.
